name: LTX-2.5 Video + Audio
description: Cinema-resolution LTX-2.5 video with synchronized audio

paragraphs: An interactive text/image-to-video with synchronized audio demo for Lightricks LTX-2.5, using the official Diffusers-compatible checkpoint.
It runs the model's published distilled two-stage recipe:

The app is intended for a ZeroGPU xlarge worker. It offers text-to-video and image-to-video; landscape, portrait, square, cinema, and native-reference 1920×1088 presets; manual clips up to 20 seconds; LTX-2.5 automatic duration up to 15 seconds; an optional remote LTX prompt enhancer with a local continuity/audio fallback; and both the tiled convolutional decoder and LTX-2.5's detail-focused diffusion decoder. High-resolution and long-duration jobs consume more shared ZeroGPU quota and may wait longer in the queue.
features: 8 steps at half the final resolution.
3 steps at final resolution, including audio-latent refinement.
